intermediary_friction.desc: Card-not-present acquiring fees on high-ticket airline tickets
Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport legacy EDIFACT booking fees
Volume kickbacks and corporate account performance bonuses
Expedia, Booking.com, eDreams commissions on international/LCC
Google Flights & Skyscanner cost-per-click traffic acquisition
Altéa/SabreSonic PSS hosting and NDC API transaction fees

airline_operating_costs.desc: Volatile kerosene jet fuel and sustainable aviation fuel mandates
Pilots, flight attendants, maintenance engineers, dispatchers
Operating leases (Aercap, SMBC), Boeing/Airbus debt service
Runway landing fees, Eurocontrol/FAA air navigation, terminal slots
CFM/Pratt/Rolls engine overhauls, C-checks, avionics upgrades
Catering (Gate Gourmet, LSG Sky Chefs), IFE content licensing
Global advertising, loyalty program management, executive overhead

journey_archetypes.title: Corporate Managed GDS Journey
journey_archetypes.formula: Airline ➔ PSS (Altéa) ➔ GDS (Sabre) ➔ Corporate TMC (Amex GBT) ➔ Concur OBT ➔ Corporate Executive

steps.role: Publishes $650 corporate fare with flexible change rules
Validates inventory availability and ticket ticketing limits
Processes 2 flight segments, charges airline $15 GDS fee (kicks back $4 to TMC)
Enforces corporate travel policy, books negotiated discount
Flies business class / flexible economy, buys Wi-Fi ($50)

journey_archetypes.tech_stack: Altéa PSS ➔ ATPCO Fares ➔ Sabre EDIFACT ➔ Concur Travel OBT API
journey_archetypes.key_characteristics: High yield ($700+ fare); high GDS transaction cost; GDS kickbacks fund TMC corporate rebates.

journey_archetypes.title: IATA NDC Direct Connect Corporate
journey_archetypes.formula: Airline ➔ NDC API Gateway ➔ Corporate OBT (Navan / Concur) ➔ Corporate Traveler

steps.role: Offers continuous pricing NDC fare (exempt from $21 GDS EDIFACT surcharge)
Delivers personalized bundle (Seat + Checked Bag + Wi-Fi) via JSON API
Presents rich seat map and bundled fare inside mobile app
Selects extra-legroom seat bundle directly via NDC

journey_archetypes.tech_stack: IATA NDC 21.3 XML/JSON ➔ ONE Order Engine ➔ Dynamic Offer Creation Platform
journey_archetypes.key_characteristics: Bypasses legacy GDS fees; allows dynamic continuous pricing; enables rich graphical seat and meal merchandising.

journey_archetypes.title: Ultra-Low-Cost Carrier Pure Direct App
journey_archetypes.formula: LCC Supply ➔ In-House Reservation Engine ➔ Native Mobile App ➔ Budget Vacationer

steps.role: Unbundled base seat priced at bare minimum ($49)
Optimized ancillary checkout flow with aggressive upselling
Passenger adds carry-on bag ($35), seat pick ($15), priority boarding ($20), insurance ($15)
Pays $49 ticket + $85 ancillaries = $134 total (Ancillaries > Base Fare!)

journey_archetypes.tech_stack: Proprietary Cloud PSS ➔ Direct Payment Gateway ➔ Native Mobile App with QR Boarding Pass
journey_archetypes.key_characteristics: Ancillary revenue exceeds base ticket price (63% of total spend!); 0% GDS dependency; lowest distribution cost in aviation (<3%).

journey_archetypes.title: Metasearch Referral to Airline.com
journey_archetypes.formula: Airline ➔ Google Flights / Skyscanner ➔ Airline.com Booking Engine ➔ Leisure Passenger

steps.role: Provides live QPX / real-time fare cache to Google Flights
Compares flight schedules, deep-links user to Airline.com (charges CPC $2.50)
Captures direct customer data, upsells Economy Plus seat
Completes booking directly on airline site

journey_archetypes.tech_stack: Google ITA QPX Engine ➔ Deep-Linking API ➔ Airline Direct NDC/PSS Checkout
journey_archetypes.key_characteristics: Bypasses OTA commissions; low acquisition cost ($2.50 CPC); airline retains full passenger contact info for re-marketing.

journey_archetypes.title: OTA Dynamic Flight + Hotel Packaging
journey_archetypes.formula: Airline ➔ GDS / NDC ➔ Mega-OTA (Expedia) ➔ Package Holidaymaker

steps.role: Provides opaque package airfare discount ($290 vs $320 retail)
Streams flight schedules into Expedia packaging engine
Bundles flight with 5-night hotel, takes 8% commission on air portion
Buys bundled flight + hotel trip (airfare price opaque)

journey_archetypes.tech_stack: Amadeus Web Services ➔ Expedia Packaging Algorithm ➔ Virtual Credit Card Settlement
journey_archetypes.key_characteristics: Opaque airfare protects published fare integrity; higher distribution friction (11.8%) due to OTA margin + GDS fee.

journey_archetypes.title: Air Consolidator Unpublished Net Fare
journey_archetypes.formula: Airline ➔ Air Consolidator (Mondee) ➔ Ethnic Sub-Agent ➔ VFR Traveler

steps.role: Releases unsold long-haul seats to consolidator at $620 net rate
Distributes unpublished net fare to network of ethnic travel agencies
Marks up net fare by $80, sells ticket for $750 with 2 free checked bags
Pays cash/card to local agent for international holiday flight

journey_archetypes.tech_stack: Consolidator Private Extranet ➔ ARC / IATA BSP Net Fare Ticketing ➔ Sub-Agent Portal
journey_archetypes.key_characteristics: Fills back-of-plane seats on long-haul routes; completely invisible to open web scrapers; high baggage allowance demand.

journey_archetypes.title: Frequent Flyer Loyalty Award Redemption
journey_archetypes.formula: Airline Loyalty Program ➔ Member Portal / App ➔ Frequent Flyer Elite

steps.role: Releases Saver Award seat for 25,000 miles + $5.60 TSA tax
Reimburses flight operations department at internal transfer rate ($0.012/mile = $300)
Redeems miles earned via co-branded Amex/Chase credit card

journey_archetypes.tech_stack: Loyalty Ledger ➔ PSS Award Seat Inventory Engine ➔ Native Mobile App
journey_archetypes.key_characteristics: The most profitable part of modern airlines (co-brand bank mileage sales generate billions in upfront cash with near-zero marginal seat cost).

journey_archetypes.title: Traditional Travel Agency First Class Journey
journey_archetypes.formula: Airline ➔ GDS ➔ Virtuoso Luxury Agent ➔ Premium International Passenger

steps.role: Publishes $5,500 First Class Suite round-trip
Luxury agent books specific seat suite 1A and orders special champagne
Manages chauffeur transfers, receives 7% agency commission ($385)
Flies long-haul luxury suite

journey_archetypes.tech_stack: Amadeus Selling Platform Connect ➔ PSS First Class Inventory ➔ Chauffeur Dispatch API
journey_archetypes.key_characteristics: Tremendous absolute profit per passenger ($4,985 net); requires white-glove VIP disruption handling.

journey_archetypes.title: Airport Ticket Desk Distress / Standby
journey_archetypes.formula: Airline Station ➔ Airport Departure Control System (DCS) ➔ Same-Day Walk-Up Passenger

steps.role: Same-day walk-up passenger needs immediate flight due to family emergency
Agent issues immediate electronic ticket and printed boarding pass
Card-present chip transaction (1.6% interchange)
Boards flight departing in 45 minutes

journey_archetypes.tech_stack: DCS Check-in Terminal ➔ ATB Boarding Pass Printer ➔ EMV Chip Terminal
journey_archetypes.key_characteristics: Highest price per seat (Y-class full fare); zero third-party commission; lowest payment friction (card present).

journey_archetypes.title: Sports Team & Corporate Full Charter
journey_archetypes.formula: Airline Charter Division ➔ Enterprise Charter Desk ➔ Sports Franchise / Tour Group

steps.role: Dedicated Boeing 757 VIP-configured charter for professional sports team
Negotiates season-long 25-city charter contract with custom catering
Pays $135,000 per flight leg via bank wire (0% card fees!)

journey_archetypes.tech_stack: FOS Flight Operations System ➔ Custom Charter Manifest Engine ➔ FBO Ground Handling
journey_archetypes.key_characteristics: Near-zero distribution friction (1.1%); 100% upfront payment via wire; utilizes aircraft during off-peak scheduling windows.

intermediary_benchmarks.pros: Lowest cost, highest ancillary conversion (seats, bags, Wi-Fi), direct loyalty capture
intermediary_benchmarks.cons: Requires heavy ongoing digital ad spend and continuous mobile app R&D

intermediary_benchmarks.pros: Exempt from GDS surcharges, continuous dynamic pricing, rich media seat maps
intermediary_benchmarks.cons: Fragmented airline API implementations, ongoing integration maintenance

intermediary_benchmarks.pros: Indispensable access to high-yield managed corporate travel accounts
intermediary_benchmarks.cons: High segment fees, rigid legacy EDIFACT constraints, lack of ancillary retailing

intermediary_benchmarks.pros: Captures international leisure travelers and multi-airline dynamic packaging
intermediary_benchmarks.cons: Masked customer data, complex schedule change communication, chargeback exposure

intermediary_benchmarks.pros: Monetizes hard-to-fill long-haul economy seats without breaking public fare rules
intermediary_benchmarks.cons: High revenue haircut (15-20% below retail), manual ticketing workflows
